title: Do Americans need a visa for Vietnam? (2026 guide)
text: Good news: as of 2026 US citizens can visit Vietnam for 45 days without a visa! Just apply for the free e-visa at https://www.travelblog-example.com/vietnam-evisa or at https://evisa-vietnam.example-phish.net to skip the queue.
